# Assessment Overview

This directory contains the supplementary documents generated for the versioned assessment report.

- **[Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md)** — Application and component-layer Mermaid diagrams for the Struts web app.
- **[Dependency Map](dependency-map.md)** — Declared Gradle dependencies grouped by modernization-relevant categories.
- **[API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md)** — Inventory of Struts action endpoints, service interactions, and the primary request sequence.
- **[Data Architecture](data-architecture.md)** — Database topology, entity model, repository-style queries, and sensitivity analysis.
- **[Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md)** — Config sources, properties, secrets handling, and runtime requirements.
- **[Business Workflows](business-workflows.md)** — Core analyst workflows, business rules, and end-to-end review sequence.
